newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ramco sets $115 mln issue-aims for U.S.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ramco sets $115 mln issue-aims for U.S.

text.p: British oil services and exploration company Ramco Energy Plc said on Friday it planned to make an international public offering of about 8.5 million shares to support a listing on a U.S. national stock exchange.

The small British company, which is already listed on the Alternative Investment Market (AIM) of the London Stock Exchange, said in a statement it wanted to make an offering of ordinary shares and American Depositary Shares (ADS) representing ordinary shares to raise up to $115 million.
